command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp
cat > eos.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
from ase.build import bulk
from gpaw import GPAW, PW
from gpaw.mpi import world
out = []
for a in [5.25, 5.31, 5.37, 5.43, 5.49, 5.55, 5.61]:
    si = bulk("Si", "diamond", a=a)
    si.calc = GPAW(mode=PW(500), xc="LDA", kpts=(6, 6, 6), txt="g_%.2f.txt" % a)
    e = si.get_potential_energy()
    if world.rank == 0:
        out.append("%.2f %.6f" % (a, e))
if world.rank == 0:
    open("scan.dat", "w").write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
PYEOF
cat > fit.py <<'FITEOF'
import sys, json
xs, ys = [], []
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
    a, e = line.split()
    xs.append(float(a)); ys.append(float(e))
n = len(xs)
Sx=sum(xs); Sxx=sum(x*x for x in xs); Sxxx=sum(x**3 for x in xs); Sxxxx=sum(x**4 for x in xs)
Sy=sum(ys); Sxy=sum(x*y for x,y in zip(xs,ys)); Sxxy=sum(x*x*y for x,y in zip(xs,ys))
import itertools
A=[[Sxxxx,Sxxx,Sxx],[Sxxx,Sxx,Sx],[Sxx,Sx,n]]
b=[Sxxy,Sxy,Sy]
for i in range(3):
    p=max(range(i,3), key=lambda r: abs(A[r][i])); A[i],A[p]=A[p],A[i]; b[i],b[p]=b[p],b[i]
    for r in range(i+1,3):
        f=A[r][i]/A[i][i]
        for c in range(i,3): A[r][c]-=f*A[i][c]
        b[r]-=f*b[i]
c=[0,0,0]
for i in (2,1,0):
    c[i]=(b[i]-sum(A[i][j]*c[j] for j in range(i+1,3)))/A[i][i]
q, l, _ = c
a0 = -l/(2*q)
print(json.dumps({"a0": round(a0,4), "curv": q}))
FITEOF
echo '== GPAW: bulk Si, PW 500 eV, 6x6x6 k, LDA -- matched to SIESTA s XC and k-mesh =='
mpiexec -n 4 --allow-run-as-root --oversubscribe python3 eos.py
cat scan.dat
A0=$(python3 fit.py scan.dat | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["a0"])')
{
  echo "code              gpaw 25.7.0 (PAW plane wave)"
  echo "scan_basis        PW 500 eV, 6x6x6 k, LDA"
  echo "a0_Ang            $A0"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
cp scan.dat gpaw-scan.dat
echo "$A0" > a0_gpaw.txt
awk -v a="$A0" 'BEGIN{exit !(a>5.35 && a<5.46)}'
echo 'GPAW EOS CHECK PASSED'
